what: Paints the cursor path on an 8px cell grid. Each passed cell leaves a square dot that shrinks 8 → 2px and fades over .45s (up to the latest 40 cells), and fast movement fills in the gaps between cells. On press, 14 square dots of 4·8·12·16·24px scatter within a 40px radius from that spot and go out over the same duration. The canvas covers the screen with mix-blend-mode: difference, so it stays visible on both light and dark backgrounds.

options.keep: Number of tail cells to keep, default 40
options.burst: Number of dots that burst on press, default 14 (0 means no burst)

note: The dot color is a mix of the skin’s --kf-dim and --kf-raised (original #b8ada0). It is not applied on touch devices (hover false)
